sources.notes: Rendered south oblique: Occulo boundary, plain side shop, segmental stone heads, slate-hidden front parapet.
Rendered central frontage, six tall and nine smaller windows plus terminal bay. Current Silcocks fascia and frosted neighbouring shop.
Rendered north oblique distinguishes terminal pediment and carved doorway from adjacent Empire/Neville Buildings.

Actual photogrammetry inspected in four quarter-turn orbits and closer rear oblique. Truncated hip, rectangular top cover, rear wing and lower attached volume. Distorted roof pixels are not survey dimensions.
Top-down roof plan inspected. Ground scale 5 m about 84 px, but elevated roofs are enlarged by perspective/parallax; relative proportions and registered neighbour boundaries govern dimensions.

Full frontal 1500x1000 exterior photograph inspected. Shop unit area 119 square metres is not the full architectural footprint. Photo date not supplied; same masonry and shop layout as July 2026, obsolete hanging estate sign omitted.
Reference photograph only; no pixels included in generated materials.
Indexed catalogue text identifies combined 367 Lord Street and 3–9 Nevill Street holding. PDF image retrieval denied by CDN; plans not inspected and no dimensions inferred from them.
Official operator identity corroboration. Linked image retrieval via web tool failed; frontage detail taken from verified imagery instead.
Confirms Jackpot Unit 1 and Unit 2 at 5–7 Nevill Street.
